overview: Kicks The Complete Sneakers Store — a luxury cinematic ecommerce website for premium sneakers. Features a full shopping cart with slide-in drawer, complete checkout with Cash on Delivery and PhonePe UPI payment options, order notifications to the store owner via email, and a premium dark theme with pink-to-purple gradient accents.
features: Luxury cinematic dark theme with pink-to-purple gradients
Slide-in cart drawer with quantity management and live totals
Full checkout with COD and PhonePe UPI payment options
PhonePe payment screen with UPI ID and payment instructions
Order notifications emailed to store owner on every purchase
Order success page with generated order ID
15+ premium sneaker products with sizes and pricing in INR
Hero section with KICKS in luxury gradient typography
